answer: A new identity serves a probation of 7 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the cedar queue naming the spiral that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, each duplicate self costs 7 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the ridge record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
